name: Interworky Assistant
author: Interworky

sections.description:
What is Interworky?

Interworky is an AI-powered chatbot that answers visitor questions, books appointments, and improves engagement on your website.

**Demo Video**

Watch our demo video to see Interworky in action: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gHs4bef7ui0

You can also check out our full tutorial playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLFQ9u6oUNWSUTxNS2yMVrx8pA9yqt0-kx

Fast & Powerful AI Chatbot

– Sync Your Website Content
→ Let the chatbot learn from your website with just one click.

– Powered by GPT
→ Uses the latest AI to provide accurate, human-like responses.

– Voice Mode
→ Chat with visitors using real-time AI voice interactions.

– View All Chat Logs
→ Analyze visitor questions and improve your website.

Customize Your Chatbot

– Change Appearance → Adjust chatbot colors, avatar, and branding.
– Personalize Behavior → Define chatbot personality and greeting messages.
– Custom Knowledge Base → Add FAQs and predefined answers.

—

Chatbot Display Options

You control where the chatbot appears:

✅ Show on all pages → Display chatbot everywhere.
📌 Show only on certain pages → Select pages where the chatbot should appear.
🚫 Hide on specific pages → Exclude pages from showing the chatbot.

—

Need Help?

If you run into issues:
– Check your API Key → Settings → Interworky Assistant.
– Clear cache → Refresh your website after changes.
– PHP 7.2 or higher is required.
– Read our Documentation.
– Support? Join our Discord or email hello@interworky.com.

—

Report Bugs

Found a bug? Let us know in our Discord Server.

—

External Services

This plugin connects to Interworky’s AI Chatbot API to provide chatbot functionality.

– Service Name: Interworky AI Chatbot
– Purpose: Provides AI-powered chat interactions on your website.
– Script Source: Loads an external script from:
– https://storage.googleapis.com/multisync/interworky/production/interworky.js
– Data Sent:
– Includes visitor interactions, page URLs, and user queries.
– No personal data is collected unless enabled by the website owner.
– Privacy & Terms:
– Interworky Terms of Service
– Privacy Policy

—
sections.installation:
Installation Guide

Step 1: Create an Interworky Account

Sign up on Interworky.com.

Step 2: Get Your API Key

  1. Go to Interworky Dashboard → Integration → API Key.
  2. Copy the API Key and paste it into Settings → Interworky Assistant in WordPress.

Step 3: Your chatbot is live!
sections.faq:
How do I get my API Key?

  1. Create an account on Interworky.com.
  2. Find your API Key in the Integration Dashboard.
  3. Copy and paste it into Settings → Interworky Assistant in WordPress.

Is Interworky Free?

Yes! You can use Interworky for free.
Premium features like appointment mode and lead collection are optional upgrades.
If pricing is an issue, email us at hello@interworky.com.

Where can I find video tutorials?

You can follow along step-by-step on our YouTube playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLFQ9u6oUNWSUTxNS2yMVrx8pA9yqt0-kx

—
